title: Bound WASI inspection Job decode ownership
question: Does pre-admitting typed inspection Jobs preserve buffered source behavior at a practical Preview cost?
summary: Matched Preview adds about 0.012 seconds on a near-1 MiB Job and clears the 0.050-second gate. Exact and adjacent resource controls, read-ahead, raw errors and held Job lifetime pass.

workloads: Matched two-row hosted Preview with a compact and a near-1 MiB 63-formula Job.

validation.summary: Three matched pairs per shape, same pinned worker assets and exact reply. Resource-contract reactor exercises early and second-fill denial, raw I/O parity, >1 MiB virtual Job and formula pause.

limitations: Component latency and requested allocation layouts. The consuming Run uses a separate entry and owner.
exclusions: Whole-job elapsed gain and total process memory.
